[Verse 1]
You set the alarm for half past two
And drag a blanket to the roof
The weather called for something new
The sky is giving you no proof

[Chorus]
Stay awake for the falling light
Nothing drops across the night
You brought the cocoa in a flask
A meteor is a lot to ask

[Verse 2]
At three the neighbour's porch goes dark
At four a plane pretends to fall
You clap for it, a borrowed spark
It isn't much, you'll take it all

[Chorus]
Stay awake for the falling light
Nothing drops across the night
You brought the cocoa in a flask
A meteor is a lot to ask

[Bridge]
The dawn comes up the colour of tea
Your blanket's damp, the flask is dry
You didn't see a single streak
But you were looking at the sky

[Chorus]
Stay awake for the falling light
Nothing drops across the night
You brought the cocoa in a flask
A meteor is a lot to ask
